title: Hearty Japanese Pork Stir fry
description: A savory and satisfying Japanese dish from the Tohoku region, featuring pork, herbes-de-provence, and stir-fry, all cooked in a traditional donabe vessel.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a donabe vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork to the donabe and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion to the donabe and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the donabe and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the donabe and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the herbes-de-provence, soy sauce, and chopped green onions to the donabe and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the stir-fry for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the hearty Japanese pork stir-fry hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
